cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says one learner identifier is used across education systems, or that learner records are linked to the national ID or another sector.
cells.note: The Teachers Service Commission said in August 2024 that TSCMIS is connected to the School Information System, the civil service HR system and Treasury pensions to exchange teacher data, two education systems exchanging data in use. Nothing says a learner identifier is used across systems, so not 4.
